programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered. Can he avenges his brother's death?

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: The planned reburial of a town elder goes awry as the corpse resurrects into a hopping, bloodthirsty vampire, targeting everyone responsible for digging the grave. A Taoist Priest and his two disciples attempt to stop the terror.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: Berkencan bisa mematikan. Makan malam Violet dengan Henry diakhiri dengan serangkaian panggilan telepon yang menghadirkan pilihan berbahaya: membunuh teman kencannya atau kehilangan anaknya.

programme.title: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: A young woman must stop a group of people seeking immortality by stealing Dracula's remains.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Dua tahun setelah amukan M3GAN, penciptanya, Gemma, menggunakan kembali ciptaannya yang terkenal itu untuk mengalahkan Amelia.

programme.title: Boycott
programme.desc: Boikot selama 13 bulan terhadap penggunaan layanan bus di Alabama setelah seorang wanita kulit hitam menolak menyerahkan kursinya kepada seorang pria kulit putih.

programme.title: Cinema Verite: The Saga of an American Family
programme.desc: Melihat di balik layar proses terbentuknya keluarga Amerika pertama yang menjadi subjek acara TV realitas.

programme.title: Seven
programme.desc: Dua orang polisi dihadapkan dengan situasi yang mengerikan saat seorang pembunuh psikopat menggunakan tujuh dosa besar sebagai modus operandi dalam pembunuhannya.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: Seorang programmer komputer rata-rata berlatih untuk menjadi harapan terakhir umat manusia untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: EuroTrip
programme.desc: Setelah dicampakkan oleh pacarnya, seorang lulusan SMA memutuskan untuk memulai petualangan ke luar negeri di Eropa bersama teman-temannya.

programme.title: Hustle And Flow
programme.desc: Seorang germo sekaligus pengedar narkoba yang mengalami krisis paruh baya membentuk sebuah band bersama temannya untuk menyalakan kembali gairahnya terhadap musik.

programme.title: Path to War
programme.desc: Presiden Johnson dan tim kebijakan luar negerinya berjuang dengan keputusan untuk mengakhiri perang Vietnam dalam film HBO Original ini.

programme.title: Pu-239
programme.desc: Seorang pekerja di pembangkit listrik tenaga nuklir Rusia mencuri sejumlah kecil plutonium tingkat senjata dan mencoba menjualnya di pasar gelap Moskow.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bret Maverick, yang membutuhkan uang untuk turnamen poker, menghadapi berbagai kesialan dan tantangan lucu, termasuk seorang pencuri wanita yang menawan.

programme.title: Drop

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Jett yang suka bersenang-senang Jett mengantarkan paket untuk anak-anak di seluruh dunia dalam serial animasi ini. Jett bekerja sama dengan Super Wings, sekelompok pesawat yang dapat berubah menjadi robot, untuk mengatasi tantangan baru dan mengatasi masalah yang mengajarkan keterampilan pemecahan masalah dan pentingnya keanekaragaman budaya. Awak Super Wings termasuk direktur misi Jimbo, helikopter penyelamat Dizy, guru gadget Donnie, dan ahli navigator Jerome - bagian penting dari grup karena pesawat melakukan perjalanan ke 52 kota di 45 negara dalam petualangan mereka, membutuhkan seseorang yang dapat membantu navigasi .
